notes: Routes are frame-stepped from emulator.start (power-on) with emulator.step unit=frame. Step notation 'button:hold:release' = hold button(s) for N frames then release for M frames; '_' = no buttons. Route helpers: scratch/route.py (ROUTES), scratch/go2.py (prefix '!' = trace enabled for that step). Tracing: trace.configure enabled=true capacity=0 (aggregates only); tracing slows emulation ~9x so non-new segments were run with tracing disabled. Snapshot files (same-build, local only) in scratch/snaps/. Artificial RAM patches are marked; their execution is observed-in-artificial-state, not natural reachability.
